name: Ryten and Kvalvika beach
why: Over a bog pass to a wild white beach between cliffs, then up Ryten for the famous view of Kvalvika from above.
book: Free; parking at Innerpollen near Fredvang.

points.name: Fredvang
points.note: The car park by the lagoon.

points.name: Kvalvika Beach
points.note: A white beach in a bay closed by steep mountains.

points.name: Ryten
points.note: A 543 m top with a cliff dropping to the beach.
